facades.note: Pixel boxes are on the 1000 px wide working copy (the 3348 x 4519 original scaled by 0.2987). Horizontal scale comes from the massing: the facade face of the 'Galerie des chimeres' part (50 m, buttress to buttress) spans image columns 72-900. Vertical scale: ground row 1258, tower-top row 138 = 69 m (OSM height of both towers).
